consent.title: Your Privacy Matters
consent.subtitle: Please read and accept before proceeding
consent.dataCollectionText: Your information will be used to prepare your case for review by healthcare professionals at this facility.
consent.aiProcessingText: An AI system will help organize your information. A doctor will always review and verify all information before making any clinical decisions.
consent.documentAnalysisText: If you upload medical documents, AI will help extract information from them. The doctor will verify all extracted information.
consent.importantText: This system does NOT diagnose diseases or prescribe medications. It only helps collect and organize your information for the doctor.
consent.mustAccept: You must accept the consent to continue
